items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 144:1
items.html: The three garments of the Nukva are IBM, and the garment of the nursing is her middle garment, the garment of the pregnancy is the outer garment, and the garment of the Mochin is her inner garment. (Item 165).
